Key: Final scores are distinct 20‑bit numbers; each internal node (group size 2ⁿ) splits into winners/losers via a Catalan C_{2^{n‑1}} ways (ballot condition).  
N = ∏_{j=0}^{19} (C_{2^{j}})^{2^{19‑j}}.  
Compute v₅(N)=∑2^{19‑j}·v₅(C_{2^{j}}) using Legendre: v₅(N)=121 818, v₂(N)=524 287 ⇒ k=min=121 818.  
k mod 10⁵ = 21 818.
